spell.dreamstar.dream_star_domain.descri: Unfold a 40-block spherical domain for 60 seconds. A planet and galaxy shimmer beneath your feet, the sky fades into violet star clouds on entry, and stars sparkle on boundary blocks. While inside their own domain, the caster gains Dream Star Domain: +40% ice spell power, +20% movement speed, and hovering one block above the ground; hold sneak to descend.
command.dreamstar.preview: Started a 60-second domain preview (debug: no mana cost or cooldown).
ui.dreamstar.family_domain_active: You or one of your pets already has a Dream Star Domain active (%s s remaining).
ui.dreamstar.time_lock.damage: Stores incoming damage; releases it as Ender spell damage
ui.dreamstar.time_lock.combo: Held inside Dreamstar Domain; whale breach releases 3x stored damage
spell.dreamstar.time_crystal.description: Summons time crystals that orbit evenly behind the caster’s head counterclockwise for 10 seconds. If a hostile creature is within 40 blocks, or the caster has attacked a non-friendly unit, one crystal launches each second straight through the caster’s screen centre; after launch, the crystal itself acquires a target and curves toward it. Cast again to launch every remaining crystal straight forward and end the state. This is an Ender spell; launched crystals leave white End Rod trails and burst into white particles on impact.
ui.dreamstar.time_crystal.auto: Auto-launches when a hostile target is in range or after attacking a non-friendly unit; launched crystals curve-track by themselves
